integrity: The all-group proof and portable small-case checker are included. Finite tests supplement but do not replace proof. Literature inspections and limitations are recorded in AUDIT.json.
scientific_limitations: Finite abelian Takasaki quandles only; counts actual good involution maps rather than their symmetric-quandle isomorphism classes. The displacement characterization and matching ideas have literature precedents; only the evaluated full fixed-point distribution and binary-rank formula are claimed as an arithmetic refinement. Unindexed equivalent formulas remain possible. No independent audit.
title: Fixed-point polynomials of good involutions of finite abelian Takasaki quandles
